plugins.name: itqan
plugins.description: Itqan — engineering skills suite (إتقان: mastery of the craft). 12 model-agnostic skills running the full software-engineering lifecycle: a resumable orchestrator (engineer), six phases (define, blueprint, construct, verify, inspect, release), and five specialists (discover, design, harden, assess, learn), with auto-detected discipline packs for backend, frontend, mobile, AI/ML, and any language. Approval gates before code, test-first builds, evidence before "done". Invoked explicitly, never auto-triggered.
